thesis: The site is the farm stand's tagging table: every fact arrives as a string-tied manila crate tag carrying status, weight, date checked and sample price; scrolling flips tags to their how-we-know side.

signature.name: crate-tag
signature.summary: A CSS primitive .tag shaped like a manila tag with punched hole and dashed string line; front carries status pill, item name, weight/unit, sample price and date-checked in mono; back reveals how-we-know note on tap/hover. Reused in hero mosaic, services, prices, reviews, tools and footer sign-off. Hook: data-sw-signature='crate-tag'.

palette.family: Kraft Paper + Field Ink + Berry Signal

motion.intro: Tags drop on strings onto mosaic tiles and settle (ease-out, no bounce); h1 readable before start.
stories: Freezer-math fills drawn chest freezer with cut blocks via scroll pin >=640px
Picked-out check result wipes as tag flip
motion.hover: Hairline under tag grows scaleX(0->1) from left, 200ms
